A aplicação das tecnologias e know-how GEA nos processos do time de Powder and Thermal Separation (PTS) será a área de atuação do candidato que trabalhará e fará frente com todas as demais disciplinas de Engenharia (Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação e Piping) internas da GEA e gerirá perante aos clientes externos com as tratativas técnicas de todo empreendimento e auxiliará o Project Manager a cumprir os KPI’s técnicos, financeiros e contratuais. Garantia de alta assertividade e baixo índice de retrabalho é essencial para esta vaga que deverá garantir soluções eficientes, seguras e alinhadas às necessidades dos clientes, atuando de forma multidisciplinar e sendo referência técnica dentro da equipe.

Your Profile / Qualifications

Será de responsabilidade do Engenheiro de Processos Sênior:

  • Definição/Aplicação de processos para dimensionamento de equipamentos tais como bombas, trocadores de calor, sistemas de secagem (conhecimento e experiência com Spray Drying será diferencial), evaporadores, especificação de sistemas tubulações e acessórios.
  • Elaboração de fluxogramas básicos (PFD – Process Flow Diagram) e detalhados (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram).
  • Definir e/ou aplicar soluções de know-how para definir junto aos CoC’s (Centros de Competência GEA) e garantir a correta aplicação de máquinas e equipamentos do portfólio GEA
  • Definir e estar apto a realizar double-check de balanços de massa e energia dos processos GEA.
  • Especificar equipamentos, máquinas e materiais adequados às soluções dos clientes.
  • Participar ativamente junto ao PM no desenvolvimento do projeto executivo junto aos clientes.
  • Propor melhorias técnicas e inovadoras para otimizar os processos industriais.
  • Apoiar a equipe de engenharia PMO de processos na elaboração de padrões e procedimentos.
  • Garantir que toda a documentação técnica esteja de acordo com normas e padrões da GEA e do cliente.
  • Participar de revisões técnicas e auditorias de projeto.
  • Treinar e orientar engenheiros juniores e plenos assim como demais membros da equipe.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento técnico com os membros da equipe.
  • Graduação em Engenharia (Mecânica, Química, de Alimentos, de Produção, ou áreas correlatas).
  • (Desejável): Experiência em processos de secagem por Spray Drying, leito estático e vibratório fluidizado voltado para produtos alimentícios, com ênfase em lácteos.
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de engenharia, preferencialmente em indústrias de alimentos, bebidas, farmacêutica ou química.
  • Sólida base de conhecimento em termodinâmica, transferência de calor e massa, operações unitárias, controle de processos e balanços de massa e energia
  • (Desejável): Mestrado em Engenharia de Processos, Engenharia Industrial, Segurança de processos e Engenharia Higiênica.
  • Fluência em inglês e português.
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de informática, incluindo pacote MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams), AutoCAD, SAP (desejável).

    Work closely with hardware and systems teams for end‑to‑end ECU development and validation. Interface with Tier‑1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Principal Product Manager role at AB InBev .

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We’re seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Principal Product Manager to shape the future of our sales systems and tools. In this highly autonomous, individual contributor role, you’ll lead initiatives that enhance the productivity and effectiveness of our frontline sales teams including field, administrative, and tele-sales functions.

You’ll take a step back to uncover foundational opportunities that drive long-term impact across the business. Your work will help unify sales workflows, elevate user experience, and influence how we scale and support sales organizations.

  • Develop deep expertise in how frontline sales teams operate by identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and unmet needs through research and partnership.

  • Clearly articulate trade-offs and opportunities to senior stakeholders and help guide resource allocation across teams.
What We’re Looking For
  • Proven success leading strategic product initiatives in complex environments, ideally at the principal level or equivalent.
  • Ability to think holistically and long-term, with a focus on solving systemic issues over incremental improvements.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify meaningful insights, and use metrics to drive strategic decision.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence decisions and align stakeholders at all levels.

  • Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, with the ability to collaborate closely with designers to deliver intuitive and effective sales tools.
  • Ability to evaluate technical solutions in collaboration with engineering teams and make informed decisions that balance user needs, scalability, and complexity.
  • Advanced degree in business, operations, or a related field is a plus—especially if it supports strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and organizational change. Equivalent experience is equally valued.
More about you
  • You´re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality.
  • You´re motivated by building world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world.
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;

title: Experienced UVM Verification Engineer
description:
Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics:

  • Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC,
  • SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development,
  • Development of verification plans,
  • AMBA protocols,
  • Embedded software development (C, C++),
  • Knowledge of RTL design languages: VHDL, Verilog,
  • Written and spoken English.

Other skills welcome:

  • Object Oriented Programming,
  • Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, …
  • ASIC and FPGA design,
  • Scripting (Python).

For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to:

  • Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification,
  • Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism!
  • Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions,
  • Be able to work in a team,
  • Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”,
  • And last but not least: be committed to customers’ satisfaction.
What we offer you
  • Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials,
  • Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion,
  • Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work,
  • Full time contract,
  • Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.

Our recruitment process is simple:

After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director.

If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director.

description:
O BEES é nosso aplicativo B2B, voltado a pequenos e médios varejistas do mundo todo. Usando o BEES, comerciantes e donos de bares de todo o mundo podem fazer pedidos para abastecer seus estoques, programar entregas, acessar dados do próprio negócio e muito mais.

GSF e encargos setoriais. Acompanhar ativamente o processo de Planejamento Mensal da Operação do ONS. Acompanhar e eventualmente representar o Grupo CPFL em reuniões e fóruns de discussão relacionados a comercialização de energia, risco de mercado e planejamento energético junto a órgãos governamentais (MME, ANEEL, ONS, CCEE e EPE) e associações (APINE, ABRACEEL, etc), identificando as oportunidades e impactos para o Grupo.
  • Apoiar a elaboração e implementação de estratégias de compra e venda de energia, considerando cenários de preço, consumo e risco.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações para suportar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Contribuir para a atualização e manutenção de bases de dados e sistemas de gestão energética.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para a melhoria contínua dos processos e ferramentas da área.
O que oferecemos:
  • Vale Refeição;

  • Assistência Médica;

  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

Qual a missão do Cargo?

  • SQL: Domínio de SQL para consulta e manipulação de dados em diferentes bancos de dados.
  • Comunicação: Excelente capacidade de se comunicar com times técnicos e não técnicos, explicando conceitos complexos de forma simples e direta.
Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?
  • Visualização de Dados: Proficiência na criação de dashboards e relatórios interativos. Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de mercado como Looker Studio, Quick Sight ou similares.

  • Desenvolver/executar ações relativas à prevenção de acidentes e promoção da saúde dos colaboradores por meio de auditorias, inspeções, acompanhamentos em áreas de risco, treinamentos, campanhas, palestras etc., assessorando e/ou orientando os gerentes, líderes e demais colaboradores para a eliminação e/ou controle de riscos ocupacionais, visando cumprir as atribuições definidas na Portaria 3214 / 78 e 3275 / 89, no âmbito corporativo do grupo CPFL;

Senior Quality Assurance Analyst (Analista de Garantia de Qualidade Sr.)

Local: BR / Campinas (SP) / Medley

Descrição da função

O time de Garantia da Qualidade é responsável por facilitar e verificar o cumprimento das Boas Práticas de Fabricação e dar suporte às áreas produtivas, de modo que os produtos sejam fabricados em conformidade com os Requerimentos de Qualidade da Medley e Regulamentação Sanitária.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Garantir que todo produto liberado para comercialização seja certificado e que tenha sido produzido e controlado de acordo com os requisitos do registro bem como atendido às normas de Boas Práticas de Fabricação e submetido aos testes de Controle de Qualidade.
  • Assegurar que os desvios de qualidade de menor, moderado e maior impacto sejam relatados, registrados e investigados, definindo medidas de ações corretivas e orientando as áreas de fabricação quanto à definição da disposição do processo, estabelecimento de planos de amostragem e investigação do desvio.
  • Acompanhar a evolução e tendência dos desvios de qualidade bem como a eficácia e aplicabilidade das ações corretivas estabelecidas, por meio da elaboração de relatórios periódicos.
  • Revisar e contribuir para o controle dos riscos de qualidade da companhia, utilizando a ferramenta de análise de risco da empresa, gerenciando riscos críticos e escalonando para Funções Globais.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria dos processos de fabricação, acompanhando as diferentes etapas dos processos de fabricação.
  • Suportar a equipe de liderança no atendimento de auditorias de qualidade, organizando e atendendo às solicitações.
  • Auditar o cumprimento das Boas Práticas de Fabricação nas áreas industriais, atuando como auditor nas auditorias internas anuais, seguindo legislações locais e documentos da Medley.
  • Assegurar registro, rastreabilidade, controle e manutenção de dados no sistema ERP, criando ou alterando código de materiais produtivos e em desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir o planejamento e produção corretos, criando ou alterando listas técnicas e receitas para materiais produtivos no Sistema ERP.
  • Participar como usuário Chave de projetos relacionados ao Sistema ERP, atuando em processos de cadastros de materiais produtivos.
  • Elaborar indicadores de qualidade, propondo melhorias para atingir metas por meio de análise crítica e apresentação desses indicadores.
  • Definir viabilidade e impactos de qualidade e ações necessárias para mudanças que afetem diretamente os processos produtivos, avaliando propostas de mudança pelo sistema de controle de mudanças.
  • Assistir e promover o desenvolvimento de demais analistas de Garantia da Qualidade, oferecendo suporte técnico e treinamento nas atividades e ferramentas do setor.
  • Dar suporte à coordenação nas atividades de Garantia da Qualidade, acompanhando cronogramas e prazos, e reportando a coordenação e gerência quando necessário.
  • Auxiliar no Projeto de Integridade de Dados da planta de Campinas, implementando o Plano Mestre de Integridade de Dados.
  • Realizar avaliação de risco de integridade de dados da planta de Campinas com a ferramenta DIRA e estabelecer, junto às demais áreas, planos de ação e remediação para os riscos mapeados.
  • Acompanhar a conclusão dos planos de ação e remediação estabelecidos pelo Projeto de Integridade de Dados, compartilhando relatórios mensais de performance com a liderança da Garantia da Qualidade.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das Políticas de Qualidade da Medley e das exigências da Agência Sanitária Local, analisando divergências entre documentos globais, internos e legislações aplicáveis.
  • Estabelecer procedimentos operacionais padrão do setor, elaborando ou revisando documentos no sistema de gerenciamento de documentos para atender requisitos de Boas Práticas de Fabricação.
  • Promover a integração de novos colaboradores do setor de Garantia da Qualidade, criando e aplicando mapeamento de atividades e competências baseado no Plano de Treinamento aprovado.
  • Promover a integração e o desenvolvimento profissional de estagiários recebidos, participando no processo seletivo, aplicando plano de desenvolvimento e oferecendo suporte técnico.
  • Manter conhecimento e cumprir com princípios de Ética e Integridade, políticas da Sanofi e códigos de conduta que regulam o mercado farmacêutico.
  • Cumprir e promover políticas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) da Sanofi, prevenindo acidentes, mitigando riscos à saúde, promovendo bem‑estar dos colaboradores e reduzindo impactos ambientais.
Sobre você Experiência

Conhecimento na área de Boas Práticas de Fabricação de medicamentos na indústria farmacêutica. Experiência em liberação de produto, reclamações, devolução, desvio de qualidade, etc.

  • Proatividade, dedicação, trabalho em equipe

Graduação

Farmacêutico

Porque deve nos escolher?

A Medley, unidade de negócios de genéricos da Sanofi, tem como foco democratizar o acesso à saúde no Brasil, desenvolvendo soluções voltadas principalmente para cardiologia, saúde feminina, doenças do sistema nervoso central e gastroenterologia. Há mais de 29 anos, oferecemos medicamentos de qualidade a milhares de brasileiros. A eficácia da Medley em produzir medicamentos genéricos é reconhecida e premiada, pois seguimos critérios de qualidade e rigor científico para oferecer o melhor para a saúde dos nossos consumidores.

Uma das nossas prioridades é melhorar a experiência das pessoas em suas jornadas de saúde, oferecendo conteúdos relevantes, campanhas educativas e serviços de apoio. Eficaz em tudo que faz, a Medley é patrocinadora do Comitê Olímpico do Brasil e apoia o esporte e a saúde dos brasileiros.

Persiga o Progresso . Descubra o Extraordinário .

O progresso não seria possível sem as pessoas; pessoas de diferentes origens, em diferentes locais, desempenhando cargos diferentes, mas todas unidas por um objetivo comum: o desejo de fazer os milagres acontecerem. Você pode se tornar uma dessas pessoas. Procure a mudança, acolha novas ideias e explore todas as oportunidades que temos para oferecer. Persiga o progresso e descubra o extraordinário conosco.

Na Sanofi, oferecemos as mesmas oportunidades a todos, sem olhar a raça, cor, ascendência, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, orientação sexual, idade, cidadania, estado civil, deficiência ou identidade de gênero.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

  • Partner with colleagues to build and maintain tooling for test development, automation, and release processes improvement;

  • Knowledge of software testing concepts (testability, regression, unit, integration, stress, test automation), with practical experience using Kotest , MockK , and Testcontainers ;
  • Some experience with DevOps tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Azure, etc.;
  • Intermediate communication skills in English (written and spoken);

More about you:

title: Desenvolvedor Software Pl
description:
Desenvolvedor Pl

Quem somos e por que esta vaga é especial? Nossa equipe de Plataformas de fundação (Platform Engineering) tem uma missão clara: ser o motor que acelera e simplifica o desenvolvimento de software em toda a companhia.
Estamos iniciando um dos projetos mais estratégicos da engenharia: a construção da nossa nova Plataforma de Desenvolvedor Interna (IDP) . Este é o momento perfeito para entrar.
Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em um projeto de altíssimo impacto, projetando e construindo as ferramentas, APIs e abstrações (com React e Node.js ) que serão usadas por todos os nossos times de engenharia, melhorando a developer experience (DX) e otimizando nosso ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento. Para este desafio, mais importante do que o domínio em uma única tecnologia, buscamos o que você tem de melhor: um perfil agnóstico , com excelente base técnica, mas acima de tudo, com uma curiosidade e facilidade de aprendizado para se adaptar e resolver problemas complexos.

Seu principal desafio será:
  • Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir nossas plataformas internas (React, PHP, Node)
  • Criar e manter APIs RESTful robustas, seguras e bem documentadas
  • Colaborar diretamente com as equipes de SRE, DevOps e Desenvolvimento de Produto para entender suas "dores" e propor soluções que realmente otimizem o fluxo de trabalho.
  • Atuar na documentação técnica de tudo o que for construído, garantindo a adoção pelas outras equipes.
  • Eventualmente, dar manutenção e auxiliar na migração de funcionalidades de ferramentas internas legadas (algumas desenvolvidas em PHP ), integrando-as ou substituindo-as pelas novas plataformas.
O que esperamos de você:
  • Perfil Agnóstico e Aprendizado Rápido: Esta é a sua principal característica. Buscamos uma pessoa com facilidade em aprender e se adaptar a novas tecnologias, frameworks ou linguagens conforme a necessidade do projeto.
  • Experiência Full Stack: Vivência em desenvolvimento, com conhecimentos em Node.js para o backend e React para o frontend (construção de dashboards, portais internos, etc.).
  • APIs: Vivência no desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful .
  • Mentalidade de Pleno: Autonomia para analisar problemas, propor soluções técnicas viáveis e tocar o desenvolvimento end-to-end.
  • Boas Práticas: Conhecimento em engenharia de software (Git, Testes Automatizados, Code Review, Código Limpo).
  • Desejável (PHP): Conhecimento ou disposição para atuar pontualmente com PHP para manutenção e migração de sistemas legados.
  • Experiência com containers (Docker).
Diferenciais que contam muitos pontos:
  • Familiaridade com provedores de nuvem, especialmente AWS .
  • Conhecimento ou vivência com Kubernetes
  • Experiência prévia com ferramentas de DevOps/SRE (ex: Terraform, e GitHub Actions).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de ferramentas internas, CLIs ou portais para desenvolvedores.
  • Impacto Estratégico: Você não vai trabalhar apenas em uma feature. Você vai construir a plataforma que define como todos os outros engenheiros da empresa trabalham, com impacto direto na produtividade e na qualidade da engenharia.
  • Desafio Técnico: Uma oportunidade única de trabalhar na fronteira entre Desenvolvimento e Infraestrutura, atuando em um projeto greenfield com autonomia para propor soluções.
  • Cultura de Aprendizado: Este é um ambiente que valoriza e necessita do seu perfil agnóstico, incentivando o aprendizado contínuo e a exploração de novas ferramentas.
Fazendo parte do time, você terá “SuperBenefícios” como:
  • Flexibilidade de horário: Podemos sempre nos adaptar às mudanças do dia a dia, o importante mesmo é sempre alcançar o objetivo.
  • Ajuda de custo para os dias em home office: A gente dá o suporte necessário para que você possa trabalhar no conforto do seu lar, em dias de home office.
  • Ifood Benefícios Flexíveis (VA + VR): Transformar o mundo dá uma fome, né?! E é claro que o nosso recheado VA e VR não podem ficar de fora dessa missão.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico: A saúde sempre em primeiro lugar, para você e seus dependentes.
  • Apoio aos pais: Se tornar mãe ou pai é algo espetacular, e queremos participar deste grande momento com você. Por isso, além do auxílio creche, temos também licença-parental (maternidade e paternidade) estendida.
  • Saúde e Bem-estar: Parceria com o Gympass e auxílio farmácia.
  • Treinamentos e educação: Temos parcerias com escolas e universidades e oferecemos treinamentos EaD gratuitos.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Optimization
description:
AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world. In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

About the Role

The Senior Data Scientist – Optimization will be responsible for developing solutions at the intersection of Machine Learning and Advanced Optimization, with a focus on multi-objective, lexicographic, and evolutionary methods. This role will tackle strategic challenges related to delivery optimization, freight rate modeling, and minimum order value determination, integrating demand forecasting and large-scale operational constraints. This person will lead the design and implementation of mixed-integer optimization algorithms ensuring that solutions are scalable, interpretable, and directly impact key business metrics.

What you'll do:
  • Implement and adapt PaCo (Pareto Ant Colony Optimization) algorithms for integer and mixed-variable optimization problems, addressing multiple objectives and business constraints.
  • Develop and benchmark models based on NSGA-II/III, MOEA/D, Simulated Annealing, CP-SAT, and Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP).
  • Formulate composite objective functions and lexicographic hierarchies to prioritize goals such as logistics cost, service level, and profit margin.
  • Generate short- and mid-term demand forecasts using Machine Learning techniques (regression, ensembles, neural networks, time series) and integrate these forecasts as inputs to optimization models.
  • Build automated pipelines for training, inference, and optimization, ensuring traceability, versioning, and performance using Python, PySpark, MLflow, Docker, and GitHub Actions.
  • Execute and monitor experiments in cloud-based distributed environments (Azure, Databricks), optimizing both computational performance and cost.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to align business criteria, validate results, and ensure the impact of deployed solutions.
What you'll need:
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, or related fields. A master’s or PhD in a relevant area is a plus.
  • Experience with multi-objective and lexicographic optimization (PaCo, NSGA-II/III, MOEA/D).
  • Familiarity with optimization frameworks such as Pyomo, OR-Tools, PuLP, PyMoo, Gurobi, or CPLEX.
  • Proficiency in Python and PySpark, with solid use of scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Scikit-learn).
  • Experience integrating ML models with optimization workflows (e.g., using forecasts as parameters in decision models).
  • Advanced English for working in a global environment.
  • Excellent analytical skills, clear communication, and a focus on impactful results.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with route optimization, supply chain, dynamic pricing, or last-mile logistics.
  • Knowledge of hybrid ML + OR methods (e.g., learning to estimate optimization parameters).
  • Experience with Azure Databricks, MLflow, Ray, Airflow, or other distributed computing platforms.
  • Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in multi-objective optimization.

The Senior Data Scientist will be responsible for developing solutions at the intersection of Computer Vision, Computer Graphics, and Multimodal Models. This role involves tackling strategic challenges, combining traditional computer vision techniques with cutting-edge scene reconstruction and generative AI, focusing on detection, classification, visual similarity, synthetic data generation, and multimodal interpretation.

You will work in a highly collaborative, global environment, transforming visual data into robust and scalable models, ensuring automation, efficiency, and high performance across implemented pipelines. We are looking for someone with an analytical mindset, curiosity, a strong technical foundation in the mentioned areas, excellent communication skills, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for innovation and continuous learning.

  • Develop and adapt image classification models, with experience in architectures such as EfficientNet, MobileNet, and ResNet, focusing on production readiness.
  • Work with Siamese networks for verification and visual similarity tasks, applying fine-tuning and optimization strategies for image comparison and visual integrity validation.
  • Apply and customize multimodal generative and instruction-following models such as Qwen-VL, PaliGemma, and BLIP, using fine-tuning techniques like LoRA and QLoRA, focusing on image-text alignment.
  • Have knowledge of scene reconstruction techniques such as NeRF or Gaussian Splatting, and hands-on experience with frameworks like Nerfstudio or similar.
  • Work with large volumes of visual data, coordinating curation, annotation, and qualitative evaluation strategies to ensure diversity and quality in image datasets.
  • Generate and use synthetic and 3D data as complementary sources for training and evaluating models, supporting their creation and curation to enhance model generalization and robustness.
  • Automate, version, and monitor training, inference, and deployment pipelines using Python, PySpark, MLflow, GitHub Actions, Docker, and CI/CD, running on cloud infrastructure (especially Azure and Databricks).
  • Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, PMs, and business stakeholders, ensuring technical alignment and strategic impact of developed solutions.
  • Work in an agile, global environment, participating in Scrum/Kanban ceremonies, technical reviews, and continuous delivery and learning cycles.

  • General and foundational knowledge in data science and statistics, including data analysis, modeling, and validation techniques.
  • Strong background in Deep Learning, including mastery of Transformer architectures and advanced algorithms applied to real-world problems.
  • Hands‑on experience building models for object detection, image classification, visual information extraction, and multimodal interpretation.
  • Proficiency in TensorFlow or PyTorch, with experience in model development and deployment.
  • Experience with cloud computing, particularly Azure, Databricks, and Spark, for large‑scale data processing.
  • Expertise in Python and PySpark, plus familiarity with data manipulation and modeling libraries and frameworks.
  • Knowledge of version control and collaboration tools such as GitHub, and experience with CI/CD pipelines for data and model projects.

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more.

Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App.

Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day. Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.

These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high‑growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our iOS app, being the #18 productivity app in the App Store category and also our recent recognition as Apple's Design Award for inclusivity, we find the need for a Senior iOS Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push our missing forward.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast‑paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users. We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

  • Opportunity to lead key engineering and product decisions

  • Maintain and enhance the existing complex app architecture

  • Experience working on products that scaled to a large user base

  • Responsibility for engineering the product with a customer‑obsessed mindset
Product Thinking

You make thoughtful decisions about the evolution of your product and support internal teams and designers into taking the right direction.

Speed

You work quickly to generate ideas and know how to decide which things can ship now and what things need time.

Focus

We’re a high‑growth startup with a busy, remote team. You know how and when to engage or be heads‑down.

Technical Skills
  • Swift

  • SwiftUI experience
  • Multithreading programming
  • Working with CI / CD infrastructure
  • Fastlane
  • SOLID principles, ability to write every single class according to SOLID
  • Git and understanding of different Git strategies
What We Offer

A fast‑growing environment where you can help shape the company and product. An entrepreneurial crew that supports risk, intuition, and hustle. The opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry. A competitive salary, a collegiate atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture. Work on a product that millions of people use and where daily feedback includes users sharing that they cried when they first found the product because it was so impactful on their lives. Support people with learning differences like Dyslexia, ADD, Low Vision, Concussions, Autism, and Second Language Learners, and give reading superpowers to professionals all over the world. Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech: Intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Audio.

description:
Job type: Full-time employee

O Gerente de Cybersecurity é responsável por liderar a estratégia de proteção dos ativos de informação da organização, garantindo a implementação, manutenção e evolução contínua das políticas, processos e controles de segurança. Atua de forma estratégica e operacional , coordenando equipes, priorizando iniciativas e assegurando a conformidade com regulamentações e boas práticas internacionais.

É o ponto focal para a alta gestão em temas de segurança cibernética, traduzindo riscos técnicos em impactos de negócio e propondo soluções eficazes para mitigação.

Liderança e Estratégia de Segurança

  • Apoio na definição e execução do plano estratégico de segurança da informação alinhado aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Coordenar e desenvolver a equipe de segurança, promovendo capacitação técnica e evolução de carreira.
  • Atuar como advisor para demais áreas, orientando sobre riscos e tendências de ameaças.

2. Monitoramento e Resposta a Incidentes

  • Supervisionar e priorizar investigações de incidentes de segurança, garantindo resposta rápida e eficaz.
  • Coordenar a comunicação e gestão de crises junto a stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Garantir análise de causa raiz e implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.

3. Gestão de Vulnerabilidades e Ameaças

  • Estabelecer processos de gestão contínua de vulnerabilidades e ameaças.
  • Garantir execução de correções e melhorias dentro dos prazos definidos.
  • Integrar threat intelligence para antecipar e mitigar riscos emergentes.

4. Governança, Controles e Compliance

  • Assegurar conformidade com normas e regulamentações como LGPD, ISO 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS .
  • Elaborar e revisar políticas, normas e procedimentos de segurança.

5. Treinamento e Cultura de Segurança

  • Patrocinar e supervisionar programas de conscientização e treinamentos técnicos.
  • Promover a cultura de segurança em todos os níveis da organização.
  • Apresentar relatórios executivos com indicadores de segurança, riscos e planos de ação.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Ensino superior completo em Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Redes ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 6 anos em segurança da informação, sendo pelo menos 2 em posição de liderança.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação).

Conhecimentos Técnicos Desejados

  • Arquitetura e protocolos de rede, firewall, VPN, proxy, IDS/IPS.
  • Sistemas operacionais (Windows, Linux) e automação com scripts (Python, PowerShell).
  • Ferramentas de gestão de vulnerabilidades (Orca, Qualys, OpenVAS).
  • Segurança em nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Criptografia, autenticação multifator, certificação digital.
  • Frameworks e padrões de segurança (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls).

A Ambev é uma empresa que valoriza a diversidade e a inclusão. Nosso Comitê de Autenticidade Tech trabalha para garantir que todas as questões relacionadas à inclusão sejam tratadas com carinho e responsabilidade.

B. Criação e Gestão de Agentes de IA

  • Design de Agentes: Projetar e implementar agentes de IA autônomos e multiagentes (utilizando ferramentas como N8N com integrações de LLMs, LangChain, etc.) para executar tarefas complexas.

  • Proficiência em Automação Low-Code/No-Code: Experiência prática e aprofundada na construção e gestão de fluxos complexos usando N8N (preferencial) ou outras plataformas como Make ou afins.

title: Mid-Level UX Writer
description:
AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

As an UX Writer at BEES, you will be part of the team responsible for the concept and creation of B2B solutions focused on user experience and the creation of interfaces across all BEES products. You will be working closely with fellow product designers, product management, engineering teams, and stakeholders to bring BEES products to life through delightful and effective product experiences. BEES is seeking a user‑centric and data‑driven UX Writer to support and contribute to our organization’s consumer‑facing UX writing strategy, research, and execution. In this role, you will collaborate closely with teams responsible for the concept and creation of all BEES apps and products, while reporting to the UX Writing and Localization Manager. This is a great opportunity to grow your skills in a supportive, cross‑functional environment focused on delivering clear, engaging user experiences.

What you’ll do:
  • Ownership: Assist in creating clear and consistent copy across BEES projects, supporting senior team members to maintain a unified voice throughout all products.
  • Execution: Help transform technical and complex information into simple, user‑friendly copy under guidance.
  • Organization: Support the maintenance of content guidelines and style guides, including tone of voice documentation.
  • Analysis: Learn to interpret data and use insights to inform and improve content strategy.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with different stakeholders, contributing to ensuring copy aligns with overall company goals and user needs.
  • Strategy: Develop an understanding of key product strategy metrics and how to integrate them into content decisions.
  • Writing process: Test copy ideas to best support and guide our users.
What you’ll need:
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with a passion for clear, user‑centered writing.
  • Eagerness to learn and contribute to digital products developed within a cross‑functional, iterative team environment that uses both data and user feedback.
  • Ability to think creatively about product communication while executing tasks with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Familiarity with design thinking principles and a willingness to apply them to help solve user problems effectively.
  • Experience or interest in crafting copy across various formats, from concise microcopy to longer content pieces.
  • Comfortable managing and contributing to multiple projects with guidance, maintaining quality and consistency.
  • Basic understanding of content strategy and how it supports business goals, with a desire to develop this knowledge further.
More about you:
  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.
What We Offer:
  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affinity Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Senior Business Analyst

Join to apply for the Senior Business Analyst role at Nubank

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, You’re Expected To
  • Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;
  • Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;
  • Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available; Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;
  • Understand our products and interactions with other areas;
  • Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;
  • Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.
What are we looking for?
  • Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;
  • Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);
  • Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day‑to‑day challenges and achieve the best results;
  • Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;
  • Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;
  • Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;
  • Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;
  • Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture.

title: Gerente Administrativo Financeiro
description:
Cargo

Gerente Administrativo Financeiro

Tipo de Contrato

Prestador de serviço (PJ)

1000 de auxílio transporte + 500 de auxílio saúde (após 3 meses) + seguro de vida (após 3 meses)

Diferenciais (Não Obrigatórios)
  • Experiência prévia com Conta Azul ou sistemas de ERP financeiro.
  • Conhecimento em relatórios financeiros.
  • Vivência em empresas de consultoria, serviços ou tecnologia.
  • Experiência em gestão de fluxo de caixa de múltiplas unidades de negócio.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um Gerente Administrativo Financeiro que será responsável por liderar e otimizar nossa área financeira e administrativa. As principais responsabilidades incluem:

  • Gestão Financeira Completa: Controle de fluxo de caixa, conciliação bancária, e gerenciamento das contas a pagar e receber, assegurando uma saúde financeira robusta.
  • Planejamento Financeiro e Orçamentário: Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e acompanhamento rigoroso de indicadores financeiros, visando alcançar as metas da empresa.
  • Análise de Resultados e Rentabilidade: Desenvolvimento e monitoramento de KPIs financeiros e operacionais, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e crescimento.
  • Gestão de Contratos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Responsável pela negociação de prazos e condições de pagamento, mantendo um bom relacionamento com nossos parceiros.
  • Emissão de Notas Fiscais e Relacionamento com a Contabilidade: Garantir a conformidade fiscal e contáb colaborando estreitamente com a equipe contábil.
  • Gestão Administrativa: Organização de arquivos, recepção e envio de documentos, além da supervisão das rotinas administrativas.
  • Desenvolvimento e Supervisão da Equipe: Liderar e promover o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe administrativa e financeira, garantindo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e produtivo.

Local: Campinas / Alphaville. Trabalho presencial, de segunda a sexta, com possibilidade de atuação eventual aos sábados.

Experiências e Qualificações

O candidato ideal deve ter formação superior em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas e experiência comprovada em gestão administrativa e financeira. É fundamental que o profissional possua conhecimento avançado em Excel, Word e Outlook, além de domínio em sistemas financeiros, como Conta Azul, ERP ou similares. A capacidade analítica e o foco em resultados financeiros são essenciais para o sucesso nesta posição. Buscamos alguém com habilidades de liderança e gestão de equipe, que tenha excelente comunicação assertiva e facilidade para negociar. O candidato deve ser organizado, proativo e ter alta capacidade de resolução de problemas.

Se você se identifica com este perfil e está pronto para contribuir com nossa empresa, aguarde sua candidatura!

title: SAP Specialist (MM)
description:
SAP Specialist (MM) – Norsk Hydro

Hydro Extrusions is a world‑leading aluminium extrusion business operating about 100 production sites in 40 countries and employing 20,000 people. Leveraging local expertise, a global network and advanced R&D, we offer everything from standard profiles to advanced development and manufacturing for many key industries.

Join our dynamic SAP support team as a Senior SAP Specialist MM for S4 HANA, where you will play a key role in optimizing and maintaining our SAP landscape. As a seasoned professional you will leverage your expertise in Materials Management to ensure the smooth functioning of SAP systems, troubleshoot issues, resolve tickets promptly, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities
  • Provide expert guidance in SAP MM solutions, focusing on purchasing, inventory/warehouse management and related integrations.
  • Take ownership of ticket resolution, applying strong problem‑solving skills to address issues efficiently.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams (Finance, Production Planning, Logistics) to resolve SAP‑related incidents and problems promptly.
  • Perform system analysis, design and enhancements to meet business requirements across procurement, goods movements and inventory processes.
  • Conduct regular system audits and data integrity checks to ensure optimal performance while using SAP best practices.
  • Lead initiatives for SAP system upgrades and enhancements, considering dependencies with other modules such as FI/CO, PP and SD.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for SAP configurations, processes and procedures.
  • Guide the evaluation, selection and configuration of procure‑to‑pay solutions to meet evolving business needs.
  • Support and maintain a clean‑core initiative by leveraging SAP standard functionality and best practices.
  • Implement preventive measures within SAP support processes to enhance stability and optimise supply‑chain operations.
Experience
  • Minimum 8+ years of relevant experience in a comparable SAP role (ECC 6 / S4 HANA) with hands‑on application management.
  • Proven track record of extensive and senior‑level experience in SAP, demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of Materials Management (MM) – purchasing, procurement, inventory management – with a history of delivering high‑impact solutions.
  • Strong candidates will have knowledge of three or more of the following SAP areas: procurement, inventory/warehouse management, production planning, sales operations, logistics, finance and controlling.
  • Strong continuous‑improvement mindset, excellent problem‑solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex SAP MM issues.
  • Experience in a discrete manufacturing and/or automotive environment is preferred.
Skills
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
  • Solid understanding of manufacturing business processes related to the business application(s) concerned.
  • Understanding of the technical environment of the business application(s) concerned.
  • Excellent English (verbal and written).
  • Knowledge of basic project management and change management procedures within IT.
Qualifications
  • IT / Business Degree or equivalent.
  • SAP & ITIL Certification is preferred.

The interview will be held in English.

Hydro values diverse skills and perspectives among employees. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply. Qualified applicants will be considered regardless of race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status or disability. We strive to provide equal opportunities for all to contribute and succeed with us.

Applications are exclusively through the ONE Careers website until Nov 30, 2025.

All opportunities are open to people with disabilities (PWD) and rehabilitated by the INSS.

title: Finance Leader Role
description:
Lead Accountant Job Opportunity

Lead Accountant Job Opportunity This is an excellent chance for talented individuals to develop their skills as a Lead Accountant in a dynamic environment.

Job Description

Oversee and coordinate the company's financial activities, ensuring efficient resource utilization, compliance with accounting, tax, and legal obligations, and the generation of reliable information for decision-making.

Key Responsibilities
  • Financial Management: Process invoice payments, monitor cash balances based on the Company’s cash flow needs, and prepare bank reconciliations. Keep customer and supplier master data up to date, request third-party assessments through the Compliance platform.
  • Credit and Commercial Control: Review and release customer orders in accordance with commercial risk policies, request credit line approvals from the insurer and internal managers, depending on the amount of exposure. Request credit line extensions from the insurer when necessary, control and monitor customer credit lines.
  • Inventory Management: Perform the monthly closing of the inventory module, participate in physical inventory control committees (quarterly), and record adjustments resulting from physical inventory counts (when applicable).
  • Fixed Assets and Leases: Control recorded fixed assets, manage and monitor lease agreements in accordance with IFRS 16, review monthly depreciation of fixed assets and leases.
  • Payroll Management: Calculate sales commissions payable to the sales department, review payroll processed by the accounting outsourcing company, review monthly balances to be accounted for related to health, parafiscal contributions, and social benefits.
  • General Accounting: Provide support for proper recording of accounting transactions, validate exchange rate controls on a quarterly basis, coordinate the closing and opening of accounting periods. Manage accounting structures and taxes, send the monthly closing schedule to relevant areas.
  • Additional Tasks: Respond to requests from Statutory Auditor and external advisors, respond to requests from Corporate Audit, monitor and follow up on internal control. Provide administrative support in response to requests from other areas, the Finance Manager, or other corporate management. Analyze and communicate transfer pricing adjustments, request supplier approvals in accordance with compliance criteria, manage expense reports on the Rydoo platform. Prepare employment certificates, fill out forms for supplier registration, follow up on requirements from control entities, attend to legal procedures that apply to the company.

title: Training and Development Manager
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We’re seeking a results-driven Training & Development Specialist to lead the design and delivery of high impact learning programs across our global organization. The ideal candidate will proactively identify business needs and develop targeted training & development solutions that strengthen employee performance and productivity.

  • Lead end-to-end training programs from design to delivery, achieving measurable improvements in performance and productivity.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in Training, Learning & Development, or Organizational Development.

  • Proven experience with e-learning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate, Rise) and Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Brightspace.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering and scaling learning programs that drive measurable skill development and business impact.
  • Ability to comprehend complex or technical information and translate it into clear, engaging, and effective training content.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Highly organized, results-driven, and able to work independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.

  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

A Be Neo é uma marca de longevidade, beleza e performance que combina tecnologia, ciência e uma visão moderna de bem-estar. Atuamos diretamente no mercado dos Estados Unidos, oferecendo soluções que unem telehealth, produtos premium e experiências digitais de alta performance. Nosso propósito é ajudar pessoas a viverem mais e melhor, conectando produtos, prescrição médica e marketing de performance dentro de um ecossistema digital escalável.


Estamos estruturando nosso time de Marketing e CRM e buscamos alguém que será responsável por criar, operar e evoluir todo o ecossistema de comunicação com a base de clientes, combinando tecnologia, dados e experiência do cliente para criar soluções de alta performance.


Sua missão como Analista de CRM Estratégico será construir a máquina de CRM da Be Neo, criando fluxos inteligentes de e-mail, SMS, push e automações, além de trazer uma visão estratégica de segmentação, retenção e lifetime value. Você também atuará diretamente na configuração das ferramentas e campanhas, em um papel híbrido que combina visão estratégica com execução operacional, especialmente no início.


Requisitos indispensáveis:

• Experiência comprovada com CRM, automações e email marketing;

• Forte domínio de plataformas como ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo ou similares;

• Capacidade de criar segmentações complexas e fluxos automatizados;

• Boa escrita para criação de emails e mensagens claras;

• Organização, autonomia e capacidade de estruturar processos;

• Visão estratégica de jornada, retenção e Lifetime Value.


Responsabilidades:

1) Estratégia de CRM & Retenção

• Desenhar a estratégia de comunicação com a base em todas as fases do ciclo de vida:

- Onboarding;

- Engajamento;

- Nutrição;

- Recompra;

- Retenção;

- Winback.

• Criar segmentações inteligentes para personalizar mensagem, oferta e jornada;

• Acompanhar indicadores de performance (LTV, taxa de abertura, clique, conversão, churn, reativação);

• Mapear oportunidades de aumento de receita via CRM + funil de back-end.


2) Execução & Operação CRM (Hands-On)

• Configurar e operar ferramentas de CRM (ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Twilio, etc.);

• Criar automações e fluxos completos usando tags, triggers, condições e integrações básicas;

• Criar campanhas pontuais (email blasts, SMS, promoções, notificações);

• Ajustar checkouts, listas, tags, webhooks e integrações simples quando necessário;

• Fazer QA das campanhas antes de subir (links, segmentação, layouts, textos). 


3) Conteúdo & Comunicação

• Criar (ou ajustar) textos claros e objetivos para emails, SMS e automações;

• Solicitar e acompanhar demandas com Copy e Design quando necessário;

• Garantir consistência de mensagem entre front-end e back-end. 


4) Dados, Métricas & Insights

• Criar e monitorar dashboards de CRM;

• Analisar comportamento da base e sugerir ações com base em dados;

• Estruturar relatórios semanais e mensais com insights práticos;

• Identificar gargalos na jornada e propor otimizações contínuas.


5) Integração com Times Internos

• Trabalhar junto ao time de Tráfego, Produto e Operações para alinhar funis e ofertas;

• Mapear requisitos técnicos e encaminhar demandas para o time de Tech;

• Documentar processos, boas práticas e rotinas de CRM. 


Diferenciais que nos conectam:

• Experiência em healthtech, subscriptions, suplementos ou e-commerce;

• Conhecimento de integrações simples via webhooks, tags e automações;

• Experiência com funis de back-end e campanhas recorrentes;

• Conhecimento de métricas de CRM e dashboards. 


Trabalhar na Be Neo é entrar em um movimento que está mudando o jogo.

Aqui, você participa da expansão de uma marca que une propósito, performance e inteligência, atuando lado a lado com líderes que realmente dominam growth e criatividade. E o melhor: você terá espaço real para deixar sua marca, com liberdade, responsabilidade e visibilidade.


• Formato 100% remoto ;

• Contratação: PJ;

• Remuneração compatível com o mercado.


Se você acredita em um futuro onde saúde, inovação e cuidado humano caminham juntos, essa oportunidade pode ser pra você!

title: Customer Support Officer
description:
Location: Remote


At Loqus, we believe in innovation, collaboration, personal growth and having fun. We offer competitive salary packages, flexible hours and various working arrangements (fully remote, hybrid, etc.), all within an inspiring and fast-paced environment that maintains a family-oriented approach to work and life. Join us in shaping the future of the last-mile industry.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to transforming the last-mile business, and we are currently seeking a dedicated Customer Support Officer to strengthen our support capacity during night-hour coverage.


Working Hours Requirement

 For operational efficiency, we are particularly interested in candidates based in the GMT+8 timezone (or nearby), where these hours fall within normal business times.


We are also seeking to strengthen our team coverage within the GMT–6 timezone (e.g. Brazil/South America) to ensure round-the-clock support across regions.

Applicants based in other time zones are also welcome to apply,provided they are able to work consistent night shifts.


Overall Purpose of Position

Provide fast and useful technical assistance on our applications. Answering technical queries on application issues and offering advice to solve them. The role may also include assisting with software testing as part of our quality assurance processes.


Responsibilities

• Serve as a point of contact for customers seeking technical assistance over the phone, email or customer service desk tools.

• Perform remote troubleshooting through diagnostic techniques and pertinent questions.

• Determine the best solution based on the issue and details provided by customers.

• Walk the customer through problems solving process.

• Direct unresolved issues to the next level of support.

• Provide accurate information on IT products or services.

• Record events/problems and their resolution in logs.

• Follow up and update customer status and information.

• Pass on any feedback or suggestions by customers to the appropriate internal team.

• Identify and suggest possible improvements on procedures.


Self-improvement

• Ensures to be well informed and up to date on technical requirements of the specific position responsibilities.


Supervision Received

• General direction from Head on issues of strategic importance or issues that are contentious or sensitive.


Working Conditions

• Normal working conditions.

• May be required to work unusual hours to meet support demand.

• May be required to perform some duties in the next senior position as part of personal development programme.

• May be required to work via teleworking methods.



Knowledge / Skills / Qualifications

• Excellent object-oriented skill.

• Detail-oriented.

• Ability to work independently.

• Proven experience as a Customer Support Officer or another customer support role.

• Good understanding of computer systems, mobile devices and other tech products.

• Ability to diagnose and resolve basic technical issues.

• Proficiency in English.

• Excellent communication skills.

• Customer oriented and cool tempered.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Pessoa Especialista em Segurança da Informação
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Monitorar e analisar eventos de segurança em tempo real, utilizando ferramentas de SIEM (ex: Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar).
  • Responder a incidentes de segurança (IR) com base em playbooks e procedimentos padronizados.
  • Realizar investigações forenses e análise de comportamento de ameaças (UEBA).
  • Criar e manter alertas inteligentes, regras de correlação e casos de uso de segurança.
  • Trabalhar junto ao time de DevSecOps e Engenharia de Segurança para melhorar continuamente os controles e a detecção.
  • Documentar incidentes, elaborar postmortems de segurança, e realizar melhorias preventivas.
  • Apoiar simulações de ataque e resposta a incidentes (ex: tabletop exercises).
  • Produzir relatórios de inteligência e manter o time atualizado sobre táticas, técnicas e procedimentos (TTPs) utilizadas por agentes de ameaça.
  • Avaliar continuamente a eficácia das ferramentas de SOC e propor ajustes técnicos.
  • Garantir aderência às normas de compliance e governança, como ISO 27001, NIST e LGPD.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • SIEMs: Splunk, Azure Sentinel, QRadar, Elastic SIEM ou similares.
  • Ferramentas de EDR/XDR: CrowdStrike, Defender ATP, SentinelOne, Carbon Black.
  • Ferramentas de Threat Intel: MISP, VirusTotal, OpenCTI.
  • Protocolos de rede e logs: Syslog, NetFlow, PCAP, HTTP, DNS, LDAP, etc.
  • Experiência com automação e resposta com SOAR (ex: Phantom, Demisto).
  • Familiaridade com MITRE ATT&CK e uso de frameworks de cibersegurança. Conhecimentos básicos de scripts: Python, Bash ou PowerShell (desejável).
  • Certificações como CompTIA Security+, CEH, GCIA, GCFA ou equivalente são diferenciais.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Talent Development Partner
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative and hands-on Senior Talent Development Partner to support the establishment of our newly formed Talent Development function. In this role, you will embrace a customer-centric, pragmatic approach, laser-focused on delivering maximum impact through the simplest, highest-quality solutions.

We are here for the growth and development of our customers, Turing Team Members. You will partner closely with leaders to understand their desired development outcomes, time constraints, and needs. Leveraging this knowledge, you will craft relevant, engaging learning content that drives measurable business results for our internal customers. You will seek out simple yet impactful solutions, recognizing that the most compelling learning experiences are often the most practical.


Responsibilities

  • Deeply collaborate with Turing leaders to translate team development needs into compelling, practical learning experiences driving measurable growth.
  • Design and develop engaging, multimedia-rich asynchronous learning content using tools like Articulate, tailoring for diverse styles through simple, high-impact solutions.
  • Serve as the go-to operational owner for the LMS system, curating and maintaining a dynamic, streamlined training catalog. Continuously refine materials for relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with customer needs.
  • Embody an agile, customer-obsessed mindset, rapidly producing high-quality, iterative content elevated by feedback and data.
  • Be a key driving force behind the development, engagement, and iterations of Sales and Engineering bootcamp programs.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience driving the development of L&D initiatives in a high-growth startup or late-stage tech environment.
  • Experienced leveraging LMS systems like Docebo, e-learning platforms, intranet solutions, and instructional design tools like Articulate to deliver impactful learning experiences.
  • Exceptional collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-centric approach to building relationships and delivering outstanding service to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to analyse training metrics, evaluate impact, and translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance learning solutions.
  • Demonstrated skill in translating business objectives into innovative, engaging, and practical learning solutions that drive measurable results.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the centre of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favour action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Business Analyst
description:

We move fast, we experiment often, and we're not afraid to try the unconventional approach. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Test Engineer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only ), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the Role:

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web and API-based applications. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and cross-functional teams to design and execute test strategies that support modern engineering practices and high-quality software delivery.

This role is ideal for someone with strong automation expertise, a deep understanding of quality engineering, and the ability to collaborate effectively in distributed Agile teams.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for web applications using Selenium WebDriver .
  • Create and maintain automated tests for RESTful APIs, including validation of headers, payloads, and data structures.
  • Develop and support test frameworks using Java , Cucumber , and Maven .
  • Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines within Jenkins , integrating version control and build tools.
  • Validate data integrity through SQL queries and support backend testing.
  • Troubleshoot issues by analyzing logs, debugging test failures, and collaborating closely with development teams.
  • Work with JIRA for requirement management and defect tracking, and Confluence for documentation.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, collaborate across global teams, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience with Selenium , including locators, waits, and driver configuration.
  • Strong experience in REST API testing, including JSON/XML validation, HTTP verbs, Postman, and Swagger.
  • Good experience with Java , including control structures, exception handling, and database queries.
  • Solid understanding of SQL, including DML, joins, and basic schema definitions.
  • Good experience with Jenkins , including job configuration and integrating Git/SVN and Maven.
  • Hands-on experience with Cucumber , including writing feature files and step definitions.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work with distributed teams.
  • Strong understanding of software testing best practices, debugging techniques, and problem-solving.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Allure reporting.
  • Background in test strategy definition or QA process improvements.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices or willingness to learn.
  • Experience in highly collaborative, fast-paced environments.
